feedback_history.therapist_response:
I’ve been thinking a lot about how the world feels lately—like it’s all spinning a little too fast. I remember when I thought I had it under control, with meditation and the meds, and how good it felt to just… be quiet. But after the virus, everything kind of tipped. I don’t know if it’s the body, or just my mind catching up, but now I’m shaking even when I’m sitting still. It’s not just a little flutter—it feels like my body’s screaming, and I can’t quiet it.  

I don’t know if I’m supposed to be stronger, or if this is just part of the healing. I just want to feel safe again, even if it’s just for a few minutes.  

What do you think? Would it help to keep talking about that—how it’s feeling now, or maybe go somewhere else first?
